planner.scaffoldTitle: 胸腔穿刺安全与引流行为
objectives: 规划更安全的外侧入路窗，避免常见的解剖陷阱。
把出血风险输入作为规划提示，而非单一的截断规则。
预测可复张或不可复张肺的引流压力和症状如何变化。
howToUse: 查看入路示意图，选择你想测试的进针路径。
根据病例调整出血风险和引流控制。
在揭示测压教学要点前预测引流行为。
planner.clinicalAnchor: 一名有症状的单侧胸腔积液患者正准备接受超声引导下胸腔穿刺。团队必须选择安全窗、评估出血风险，并决定何时减缓或停止引流。
planner.keyTakeaway: 超声确认在哪里进针；持续的症状和压力行为决定引流如何进行。出血决策仍需考虑指征、紧迫性、用药时机和当地政策。
planner.stopSlow: 当出现症状、压力非常负或快速大量引流引起担忧时，停止或减缓引流。
planner.triangleBody: 使用示意图演练由胸大肌、背阔肌、腋窝、肋间隙和膈肌界定的外侧窗。

gradual.label: 压力逐渐下降
gradual.description: 在更大量或出现症状之前，引流可被耐受。

biphasic.label: 后期压力急剧下降
biphasic.description: 早期引流看似合理，随后压力下降更快。

earlyNegativePressure.label: 早期负压预警
earlyNegativePressure.description: 症状和明显的压力下降可在小容量时出现。

triangle.title: 安全三角示意图
triangle.desc: 胸壁教学示意图，显示胸大肌、背阔肌、腋窝、膈肌界线、肋间隙以及首选的外侧超声窗。

posterior-medial.label: 后方/内侧
posterior-medial.teachingPoint: 脊柱附近的后方和内侧入路，肋间血管更易变异且暴露；向外侧扫查以寻找更安全的窗。

too-low.label: 低于安全的膈肌界线
too-low.teachingPoint: 进针过低会危及膈肌和腹腔结构；重新定位积液并保持膈肌可见。

mid-axillary.label: 腋中线
mid-axillary.teachingPoint: 当超声确认积液深度、肋间隙解剖和膈肌位置时，腋中线入路可能是合适的。

lateral-safe.label: 经超声确认的外侧窗
lateral-safe.teachingPoint: 经超声确认、膈肌界线清晰的外侧积液是首选的教学目标。

drainageTeaching.expandable: 可复张肺表现为压力逐渐下降和症状限制性引流。
drainageTeaching.partiallyExpandable: 部分可复张肺呈双相曲线：早期引流看似可耐受，随后压力下降更快。
drainageTeaching.trapped: 被困肺起始为负压，并在小引流量时变得非常负；症状可能较早出现。

reasons.inrHigh: 在本教学风险模型中，INR 为 3 或更高。
reasons.plateletsLow: 在本教学风险模型中，血小板为 20,000/uL 或更低。
reasons.dapt: 双联抗血小板治疗增加了操作规划的复杂性。
reasons.none: 本病例没有高风险的实验室或用药提示。

bleeding.teachingPoint: 胸膜操作的出血决策是个体化的；超声引导、指征、紧迫性、当地政策和用药时机比单一的实验室数值更重要。

pathway.scaffoldTitle: 气胸：ACCP 2001 与 BTS 2023 的比较
objectives: 将一个病例分别通过 American College of Chest Physicians 2001 和 British Thoracic Society 2023 框架。
解释为什么不稳定患者会趋于一致，而稳定的原发性自发性气胸却可能出现分歧。
判断推荐意见是由大小、症状、患者优先事项还是漏气的时机所驱动。
howToUse: 选择一个情景，查看稳定性、大小和症状的细节。
在揭示指南比较之前预测处理方案。
比较两张卡片，判断它们为何一致或分歧。
pathway.predictHeading: 在揭示比较之前预测处理方案
pathway.keyTakeaway: ACCP 2001 作为以大小和稳定性为基础的历史性参照很有用。BTS 2023 更强调症状、患者优先事项、门诊路径以及可靠的随访。

headline.escalatePal: 因持续性漏气升级至专科
headline.shortTermDrainage: 短期引流以快速缓解症状

rationale.accpStabilityNotMet: 未满足 American College of Chest Physicians 的稳定性标准，因此生理优先于大小。
rationale.accpPalEarly: 2001 框架对持续性漏气升级更早，大约在引流和系统检查后的第 3 至 5 天。
rationale.accpSspReserve: 继发性自发性气胸的呼吸储备较少，因此历史框架倾向于引流和监测。
rationale.accpStableVitals: 患者符合历史上稳定患者的生命体征标准。
rationale.accpSmallPspObserve: 少量原发性自发性气胸在 ACCP 2001 中属于观察范畴。
rationale.accpLargeOrSymptomatic: 大量或明显的症状会使历史路径转向针吸或引流。
rationale.btsTensionEmergency: British Thoracic Society 的指南将张力性生理状态或明显低氧视为高风险急症。
rationale.btsPalWindow: 当漏气持续到大约第 5 至 7 天时，2023 路径采用有时间界限的复评与升级。
rationale.btsHighRiskContext: 高风险特征，包括基础肺部疾病或机械通气/外伤背景，倾向于监护性干预。
rationale.btsSizeDeemphasized: 2023 路径对稳定、症状轻微的原发性自发性气胸淡化了大小的作用。
rationale.btsProcedureAvoidance: 当随访和再就诊注意事项可靠时，避免操作是合理的。
rationale.btsSevereRelief: 严重症状会使患者优先事项的考量转向快速缓解和监护性引流。
rationale.btsStableSymptomaticChoice: 对于稳定、有症状的原发性自发性气胸，该路径会权衡患者偏好、当地可及性以及快速缓解症状。

comparisonNote.converge: 两个框架在此趋于一致，这通常意味着生理、高风险背景或持续性漏气的时机正在主导决策。
comparisonNote.sizeVsSymptom: 经典分歧：ACCP 2001 依据大小做出反应，而 BTS 2023 优先考虑症状、患者优先事项以及随访的可靠性。
comparisonNote.palTiming: 分歧在于时机：ACCP 2001 在 BTS 2023 的第 5 天窗口之前就对持续性漏气升级。
comparisonNote.genericDivergence: 两个框架出现分歧；判断驱动差异的是大小、症状负担、当地门诊条件还是风险背景。

recurrencePrevention.highRiskOccupation: 航空或潜水等高风险职业会降低进行确定性复发预防讨论的门槛。
recurrencePrevention.recurrenceOrSsp: 复发或继发性自发性气胸应促使开展预防宣教、戒烟、胸膜固定术或手术选择以及专科随访。
recurrencePrevention.firstPsp: 对于首次原发性自发性气胸，应就复发风险、戒烟、随访和再就诊注意事项进行宣教。

headlineCode.pseudoexudate: Light 标准为阳性，但核对结果更倾向于假性渗出液。
headlineCode.definitiveSignal: {diagnosis} 具有特异性的胸腔积液信号。
headlineCode.exudatePattern: 这是渗出液模式；现在用临床背景加以收窄。
headlineCode.transudatePattern: 除非临床病史另有提示，否则这是漏出液模式。

reconciliationCode.tooSmall: 极小的积液通常先是取样决策，其次才是生化决策。
reconciliationCode.pseudoexudate: 生化标签与床旁病史不一致。在这种情形下，梯度和 NT-proBNP 有助于避免对已利尿的全身性积液做不必要的有创检查。
reconciliationCode.transudateButPretest: 生化看起来像漏出液，但临床验前概率并不低。恶性肿瘤和其他竞争性病变偶尔会显得具有迷惑性的平淡。
reconciliationCode.exudateInfection: 渗出液这一标签在意料之中，但 pH、葡萄糖、LDH、超声和培养决定它是否表现为需要引流的胸膜感染。
reconciliationCode.exudateTb: 渗出液标签只是第一个分叉。淋巴细胞为主、暴露史、ADA 和胸膜活检策略推动诊断向前。
reconciliationCode.transudateAligned: 生化和初始框架与全身性压力或胶体渗透力的改变一致；但仍应核查单侧、血性、结节状或复发等打破该模式的特征。
reconciliationCode.probabilityShifter: 胸腔积液分析应被理解为概率的调节器：它缩小搜索范围，然后由病史、影像和所选检查来完成推理。

pseudoexudateReason.proteinGradient: 血清-胸腔蛋白梯度 {value} g/dL，> 3.1
pseudoexudateReason.albuminGradient: 血清-胸腔白蛋白梯度 {value} g/dL，> 1.2
pseudoexudateReason.weaklyPositive: 在全身性漏出液背景下，Light 标准仅为弱阳性

empyema.rationale: 胸腔积液中的明显脓液即可诊断胸膜腔感染。
empyema.action: 引流胸膜腔并按胸膜感染治疗；若尚未送检则送微生物学。

malignantEffusion.rationale: 在合适的临床背景下，胸腔积液细胞学阳性可确立胸膜恶性肿瘤。
malignantEffusion.action: 对恶性肿瘤进行分期，使管理与预后和症状相匹配，并在适当时考虑分子检测。

chylothorax.rationale: 胸腔甘油三酯高于 110 mg/dL，或甘油三酯中等但存在乳糜微粒，支持胸膜腔内存在乳糜。
chylothorax.action: 寻找创伤、胸外科手术、淋巴瘤、淋巴系统疾病，或与肝硬化相关的漏出性乳糜胸。

hemothorax.rationale: 胸腔积液血细胞比容超过血液血细胞比容的 50% 即定义为血胸。
hemothorax.action: 升级源头控制和引流规划；评估创伤、操作损伤、恶性肿瘤或抗凝。

urinothoraxCreatinine.rationale: 积液/血清肌酐比值大于 1 支持尿液渗入胸膜腔。
urinothoraxCreatinine.action: 评估梗阻性尿路病变或泌尿生殖系统损伤；单纯胸膜引流通常会复发。

bilothorax.rationale: 积液/血清胆红素比值大于 1 支持胸膜腔内存在胆汁。
bilothorax.action: 查找胆道病变或近期肝胆手术，并协调确定性的源头控制。

pancreaticopleuralFistula.rationale: 胸腔淀粉酶极高强烈提示胰液进入胸膜腔。
pancreaticopleuralFistula.action: 评估慢性胰腺炎、假性囊肿和胰管漏；腹部影像和胰腺会诊通常比反复穿刺更重要。

esophagealPerforation.rationale: 胸腔积液中的食物颗粒是食管破裂的高特异性线索。
esophagealPerforation.action: 紧急升级以进行源头控制、广谱抗菌和食管评估。

urinothoraxOdor.rationale: 尿味是经典的大体观察线索，尤其在伴有同侧尿路梗阻或损伤时。
urinothoraxOdor.action: 检查积液/血清肌酐并评估尿路。

parapneumonic.rationale: 肺炎背景加上低 pH、低葡萄糖、高 LDH、有核细胞高或微生物学阳性，指向胸膜感染。
parapneumonic.action: 不要把 Light 标准当作终点；评估是否需要置管引流、按培养结果用抗生素以及分隔处理。

tuberculous.rationale: 以淋巴细胞为主的渗出液，伴有相符的暴露史和升高的 ADA，将鉴别诊断收窄至结核。
tuberculous.action: 怀疑时送分枝杆菌培养；若怀疑持续较高，胸膜活检可获取微生物学和药敏。

malignancyInPlay.rationale: 胸膜结节或强烈的癌症背景可能胜过不特异甚至漏出性的生化特征。
malignancyInPlay.action: 送足量细胞学，若细胞学阴性而验前概率仍高，则考虑影像引导或胸腔镜下胸膜活检。

repeatedNegativeCytology.rationale: 当影像或临床概率仍高时，两次非诊断性细胞学样本并不能排除恶性胸膜病变。
repeatedNegativeCytology.action: 停止仅做积液的循环，升级到胸膜组织诊断，如影像引导下活检或胸膜镜检查。

autoimmunePleuritis.diagnosis: 类风湿或狼疮性胸膜炎
autoimmunePleuritis.rationale: 伴有低 pH、低葡萄糖或高 LDH 的自身免疫背景可模仿胸膜感染。
autoimmunePleuritis.action: 在仅锚定感染之前，结合血清学、关节/全身活动度、微生物学和影像加以核对。

eosinophilic.rationale: 胸腔嗜酸性粒细胞高于 10% 提示胸膜腔内有气体或血液、既往胸腔穿刺、药物反应、石棉暴露、寄生虫、感染或恶性肿瘤。
eosinophilic.action: 用病史和大体外观判断这是与操作相关的干扰还是诊断线索。

lymphocytePredominant.diagnosis: 以淋巴细胞为主的积液
lymphocytePredominant.rationale: 明显的淋巴细胞为主将鉴别诊断收窄至结核、淋巴瘤、结节病、乳糜胸、被困肺、CABG 术后、黄甲综合征、尿毒症、药物原因和类风湿病。
lymphocytePredominant.action: 让时间线、暴露、影像和有针对性的检查决定下一个分叉。

lymphaticLeak.rationale: 伴有手术、淋巴瘤、淋巴或黄甲背景的乳白或浑浊胸腔积液，应触发脂质检查。
lymphaticLeak.action: 检查甘油三酯、胆固醇和乳糜微粒，而不要仅凭外观判断。

bloodInPleuralSpace.rationale: 血性液体可由恶性肿瘤、肺栓塞、创伤、心脏切开术后损伤、石棉性胸膜炎或血胸引起。
bloodInPleuralSpace.action: 当为大体血性时测量胸腔血细胞比容；不要把所有血清血性液体都当作血胸。

tooSmall: 用超声确认该积液是否可安全取样。
若积液 < 1 cm 且患者临床稳定，则治疗或观察可能的病因。
bilateralSystemic: 当病史明确且积液为双侧无回声时，治疗全身性病因。
若病程、侧别、发热、胸膜炎性疼痛或影像不再符合全身性诊断，则取样。
nextActions.definitiveFollowUp: 用其余的积液分析数据识别并发病变和管理风险。
pseudoexudate: 谨慎地重新归类为可能的全身性漏出液，并治疗潜在的 CHF、肾、肝或胶体渗透驱动因素。
重新评估反应；若积液持续、为单侧、变为血性或出现胸膜增厚，则取样或进一步影像检查。
infection: 用胸腔 pH、葡萄糖、LDH、培养产率和超声分隔来判断引流的紧迫性。
怀疑胸膜感染时，将胸腔积液接种到血培养瓶中。
tb: 送 AFB 涂片和培养，但要按培养产率低和结果延迟来计划。
若怀疑持续较高，进行胸膜活检以获取组织学、培养和药敏。
malignancyEscalate: 停止仅做积液的循环，转向用影像引导活检或胸膜镜进行胸膜组织诊断。
用肺复张、症状、预后和患者目标来选择 IPC、胸膜固定术或联合策略。
malignancyCytology: 送足量细胞学，并复阅 CT 或超声以寻找胸膜靶点。
若细胞学阴性但胸膜结节或癌症史仍有说服力，则转向胸膜活检。
transudate: 聚焦于 CHF、肾、肝、胶体渗透、腹膜和被困肺的生理。
除非临床病程不再符合漏出液，否则避免反复诊断性穿刺。
exudateGeneric: 用渗出液标签选择一条有针对性的分支：感染、恶性肿瘤、结核、肺栓塞、自身免疫病、术后或腹腔来源。
在临床核对后，根据剩余概率重复胸腔穿刺、观察、经验性治疗或活检。

pitfalls.pairedSerum: 不要在没有配对血清值和胸腔穿刺前临床印象的情况下解读胸腔生化。
pitfalls.diuresisCrossesLight: 利尿和全身性积液可以微小差距越过 Light 标准。
pitfalls.systemicGradientCheck: 全身性漏出液背景下 Light 标准为阳性时，应先做梯度检查，再锚定为渗出液。
pitfalls.fragilePH: 胸腔 pH 很脆弱；分析延迟、空气或利多卡因污染都可改变结果。
pitfalls.milkyTurbid: 乳白或浑浊液体可为乳糜、胆固醇、脓胸或细胞碎屑。
pitfalls.negativeCytology: 当影像或病史有说服力时，细胞学阴性不能排除恶性胸膜病变。
pitfalls.repeatedCytologyDelay: 在两次非诊断性细胞学样本后，反复仅做积液检查会延误所需的胸膜组织诊断。
pitfalls.mesothelialTb: 间皮细胞高于 5% 会降低结核的可能性，但并不能消除高风险的暴露史。

routineStudies.grossAppearance: 床旁的大体外观和气味
routineStudies.proteinLdh: 胸腔蛋白和 LDH，并配对血清蛋白和 LDH
routineStudies.ph: 在血气分析仪上及时测量的胸腔 pH
routineStudies.gramStainCulture: 革兰染色和培养，并直接接种到血培养瓶中

targetedStudies.lipids: 甘油三酯、胆固醇和乳糜微粒
targetedStudies.hematocrit: 胸腔血细胞比容与血液血细胞比容的比较
targetedStudies.ada: ADA、AFB 涂片/培养，以及当怀疑持续较高时的胸膜活检
targetedStudies.amylase: 胸腔淀粉酶，并进行针对来源的腹部或食管评估

about.title: 关于本模块
about.body: 这是一个仅用于模拟的硬质支气管镜教学模块，面向经认证或具备认证资格的呼吸科医师以及在认证项目中的介入性肺病学专科医师，在带教监督下使用。它模拟在获FDA批准/CE认证设备上的公认标准技术，符合AABIP/CHEST已发表的指导意见。它不操作任何设备，也不提供针对具体患者的医疗建议，且不涉及设备改装、超说明书临时改用或无监督操作。

overview.metaDescription: 学习硬质支气管镜的器械、适应证、共享气道通气和治疗方式；练习有序流程、气道急症情景和器械标注；然后检验你的推理。
overview.headerDescription: 建立大口径的中央气道，协调共享气道通气，并运用治疗工具——铲切减容、扩张、支架、异物取出和止血——并全程保持气道防火安全。

learn.description: 器械、适应证、通气协调、治疗、止血和气道防火安全。

practice.title: 练习
practice.description: 排列插入、铲切和支架流程；处理气道急症情景；标注器械。

assessment.title: 评估
assessment.description: 关于适应证、通气、铲切、支架、止血和防火安全的十道题。

learn.headerDescription: 从器械和适应证到共享气道通气、治疗工具、中央气道止血和气道防火安全。
learn.intro: 核心内容带你从器械学到气道防火安全。展开“深入了解”查看消融方式的选择和支架的注意事项。

demonstrations.heading: 引导式演示
demonstrations.intro: 先在正确顺序、决策路径和器械标签均可见的情况下学习每项技能，再到“练习”中脱离提示巩固同样的技能。
demonstrations.assemblyIntro: 探索 EFER 通用接口头的四个独立接口、镜管与气道的真实比例关系、经验证的操作姿态，以及各配置对应的通气和器械路径。
demonstrations.assemblyLabTitle: 探索硬质支气管镜器械组
demonstrations.assemblyLabDescription: 区分主轴向口、附件口、麻醉呼吸回路口和喷射通气口，再观察不同端帽配置的器械路径及彼此独立的临床呼吸周期，最后尝试组装拼图。
demonstrations.assemblyModeDescription: 观察每个部件与对应接口连接就位，然后检查所有连接。
demonstrations.assemblyHelp: 使用预设视图和接口图检查各个连接，再切换模式查看内部路径和呼吸相位。
demonstrations.ventilationIntro: 选择一个临床配置一致的预设，依次查看吸气、适用时的辅助送气、暂停和呼气；建模结果会持续显示，供教学演示。
demonstrations.sequencesIntro: 按正确顺序查看三个操作流程，并直接阅读每一步的细节与原理。
demonstrations.scenariosIntro: 逐一查看四种并发症情景，在每个分支直接比较更安全的路径、反馈与复盘。
demonstrations.equipmentIntro: 查看两张已完整标注的器械图；接口头图会分别标出主轴向口、附件口、麻醉呼吸回路口和固定喷射通气口。
demonstrations.equipmentReviewInstruction: 查看每个编号部件及其功能。

assembly.accessoryInstrumentRouteDescription: BPS 半硬式钳及其他兼容的细径附件可经 BB2401/BB2402 入口进入；此路径与两个通气口均不同。
assembly.accessoryPortDescription: 较小的侧向端口，可连接单门或双门附件闭孔器，供兼容的细径器械进入。
assembly.anesthesiaCircuitPortDescription: 连接麻醉呼吸回路的大型侧口，用于控制通气或自主呼吸辅助通气。
assembly.assemblyModeDescription: 从所有散开的部件中选择，并将其连接到正确接口。
assembly.animationComplete: 已根据减少动态效果设置显示静态路径。
assembly.axialInstrumentRouteDescription: 光学钳与内镜、经兼容端帽进入的吸引管，以及支架推送器，均需在完成相应配置更换后经主轴向腔进入。
assembly.complete: 组装完成。进入器械浏览前，请检查每个连接。
assembly.crossSectionSafetyNote: 本图仅用于带尺寸的教学比较。实际间隙取决于具体设备、端帽、器械、气道解剖、制造商说明和操作条件。
assembly.description: 组装 EFER 专用可通气硬质支气管镜，区分四个接口，比较临床配置一致的呼吸周期，并观察不同配置下的轴向和侧向器械路径。
assembly.dragHelp: 所有散开的部件都显示在操作区。选择“移动部件”，再将部件拖到对应接口；“提示”会显示目标位置。
assembly.egressBlockedDescription: 固定性完全闭塞同时阻断远端吸气进入和呼气回流；若要演示吸气可通过而呼气受限，应选择单独的球阀样梗阻状态。
assembly.egressOpenDescription: 呼出气体从肺经通畅的远端气道和镜管返回，然后通过所配置的近端出口排出。
assembly.instrumentRouteDescription: 先选择所需配置，再观察真实器械经主轴向路径或较小的附件入口行进。两个通气口均不是器械路径。
assembly.jetVentilationPortDescription: 喷射脉冲的专用入口，不是器械通道。
assembly.mainAxialPortDescription: 大口径水平通道；根据所选主端帽配置，可供内镜与兼容的光学钳、吸引管或其他器械进入。
assembly.magnifiedNotCommonScale: 放大显示—与其他视图不按同一比例
assembly.obstructionBallValve: 呼气性 / 球阀样梗阻
assembly.obstructionBallValveDescription: 吸气可通过动态狭窄处，但呼气受到限制；在模拟的连续呼吸中，远端潴留气体逐次增加。
assembly.obstructionFixedCompleteDescription: 固定闭塞会阻断远端吸气进入和呼气回流。
assembly.obstructionOpenDescription: 吸气可到达远端气道，呼气可在模型中无受限排出。
assembly.opticsLightDescription: 观察照明光从导光缆传至远端视野，以及图像经光学镜返回摄像头。
assembly.pairedTracheoscopePattern: 气管镜——配对短型气管镜管
assembly.pairedTracheoscopePatternDescription: 配对的 BT2205-3 气管镜管，260 mm，8.0/7.0 mm，用于与 BT2105-3 进行相同直径对照；无远端侧孔。
assembly.pathSafetyNote: 这些路径仅为示意，不是气流、压力、口径或兼容性模拟器。实际通气和附件使用取决于解剖结构、梗阻、具体设备配置、制造商说明、操作条件及临床判断。
assembly.pathwayCanvasLabel: 硬质支气管镜路径交互模型
assembly.pathwayHelp: 播放每条路径，可随时暂停；也可开启剖视图查看已组装支气管镜内部的路线。
assembly.pathwayModeDescription: 动态演示已组装套件中的通气流、器械行进路线以及光学与照明路径。
assembly.portLayoutVariationNote: 不同制造商的端口位置和端帽系统并不相同；这些标签仅适用于图示的 EFER 通用接口头。
assembly.portMapDistinctInterfaces: 四个彼此独立的接口：选择不同接口会改变可连接部件和有效路径。
assembly.proceduralPoseDisclaimer: 各操作姿态是离散的教学视图，并非连续插入轨迹。硬质镜管始终保持直线；不要据此推断镜管会弯曲或穿过气管隆嵴。
assembly.safetyNote: 本模型仅为教学重建。临床使用前，请核对制造商最新使用说明、兼容性及本地设备检查要求。
assembly.title: 组装硬质支气管镜套件
assembly.toolModeDescription: 比较常用硬质器械的形状、比例和功能。
assembly.viewHelp: 使用“旋转”或“平移”拖动空白区域。滚动滚轮或双指缩放可朝指针位置放大。
assembly.ventilationFlowDescription: 比较四种临床配置一致的呼吸周期、真实比例镜管结构、经验证的操作姿态、近端漏气以及三种远端梗阻状态。
assembly.bronchoscopePattern: 支气管镜——长型支气管镜管
assembly.bronchoscopePatternDescription: 配对的 BT2105-3 支气管镜管，360 mm，8.0/7.0 mm，用于经验证的主支气管演示。
assembly.controlledProximalLeak: 控制通气的吸气和呼气均经大型麻醉呼吸回路口，并封闭所选近端端帽。无套囊镜管仍可能在喉部周围或未完全密封的近端接口处漏气；本模型不对残余漏气定量。
assembly.conventionalVentilationDescription: 间歇正压吸气和呼气均经大型麻醉呼吸回路口，并适当封闭近端器械开口。
assembly.expiratoryEgressLegend: 呼气回流 / 被动呼气通路
assembly.highFrequencyJetPulsePattern: 快速的小容量喷射脉冲
assembly.highFrequencyJetVentilationDescription: 快速的小容量喷射形成高频脉冲模式；呼气仍为被动过程。
assembly.leakEgressContrast: 不要混淆近端漏气与呼气出口阻塞：漏气可减少气体输送；呼气出口阻塞则可能造成气体潴留。
assembly.lowFrequencyJetPulsePattern: 离散的较低频喷射脉冲
assembly.lowFrequencyJetVentilationDescription: 以较低频率输送离散的高速喷射气流；呼气仍为被动过程。
assembly.majorFenestrationLeak: 在这一较浅位置，远端侧孔位于声门上方并增加一条逸气路径。这可能增加漏气并减少远端气体输送；本模型不计算其幅度。
assembly.positionAtCarinaDescription: 远端头位于气管分叉处。
assembly.positionMidTracheaDescription: BT2203 气管镜管斜口位于本实验室专用气管腔的中央。
assembly.positionPastCarinaDescription: 经验证的支气管镜管姿态将笔直的远端镜管置于所选主支气管内，不以穿过气管隆嵴的方式插值移动。
assembly.positionRightMainstemDescription: BT2105 支气管镜管显示在经验证的离散右主支气管姿态。
assembly.positionLeftMainstemDescription: BT2105 支气管镜管显示在经验证的离散左主支气管姿态。
assembly.positionProximalTracheaDescription: 镜管已穿过声门并处于较浅的近端位置。
assembly.predictBothBranches: 两个主支气管均位于镜管远端头下游
assembly.predictContralateralFenestrations: 经支气管镜远端侧孔仍保留通向对侧主支气管的路径
assembly.predictMainstemOnly: 只有已进入的主支气管保留直接远端路径
assembly.predictionCorrect: 你的预测与本示意模型一致。
assembly.predictionPrompt: 在另行考虑呼气通路警示之前，镜管类型和远端头位置在解剖上提供哪条远端支气管路径？
assembly.predictionReconsider: 请将你的预测与高亮路径进行比较。
assembly.predictionResetNotice: 情景已改变。请先重新预测，再显示气流。
assembly.resultBothBranches: 从解剖结构看，两个主支气管均位于镜管远端头下游，因此在考虑呼气通路前仍有两条远端分支路径。
assembly.resultContralateralFenestrations: 从解剖结构看，远端主腔通向已进入的主支气管；只有当侧孔深度和旋转角度均正确时，才保留通向对侧主支气管的路径。
assembly.resultMainstemOnly: 从解剖结构看，气管镜没有远端侧孔路径，因此进入一侧主支气管后，只有该侧保留直接远端路径；其无套囊近端密封仍可能漏气。
assembly.sideFenestrationLegend: 经侧孔通向对侧的气流
assembly.sidePortAvailable: 支气管镜管侧孔只有在深度和旋转角度均正确时，才在模型中保留通向对侧主支气管的路径。
assembly.sidePortNotApplicable: 远端头尚未进入主支气管，因此对侧侧孔不是当前设置的决定性特征。
assembly.sidePortUnavailable: 本气管镜进入一侧主支气管后，没有经远端侧孔通向对侧主支气管的路径。
assembly.spontaneousAssistPulsePattern: 患者自主呼吸并伴有辅助呼吸
assembly.spontaneousAssistVentilationDescription: 患者自主吸气继续经呼吸回路进行，需要时再经同一麻醉呼吸回路口提供独立的手动或压力辅助，而不是经主轴向器械口送气。
assembly.openSystemProximalLeak: 部分自主呼吸辅助和喷射通气配置会保留开放的近端出口，但入口仍不同：辅助通气使用麻醉回路，喷射脉冲使用固定喷射口。本模型不对气体输送量定量。
assembly.tracheoscopeMainstemCaution: 反事实比较（几何尺寸匹配）：将这种短型气管镜管推进主支气管并非其预期用途，也不代表经验证的临床配置。
assembly.ventilationComparisonSafetyNote: 本比较仅为示意性教学，不计算实际潮气量、气道压力、二氧化碳清除或患者适用性。CHEST 以极低质量证据有条件支持喷射通气或控制通气/自主呼吸辅助通气；实际模式选择仍需麻醉监测、针对具体设备的设置、充分的呼气通路及临床判断。
assembly.ventilationScenarioIntro: 选择一个临床配置一致的情景，先预测端口、支气管路径和呼气行为，再显示各呼吸相位及模型气流。
assembly.ventilationSourceNote: 资料依据：Sarkiss 与 Eapen（2022）；Mahmood 等 CHEST 中央气道梗阻指南（2024 年在线发表，2025 年纸刊）；Putz 等（2016）；Pathak 等（2014）；Interventions in Pulmonary Medicine（2023）；EFER 制造商资料；以及 Yang 等（2025）。

practice.metaDescription: 在 3D 中组装硬质支气管镜套件；比较常规、自主呼吸辅助、低频喷射和高频喷射通气；并完成操作情景。

workflow.keyTakeaway: 胸膜感染的决策综合化验、微生物学、超声复杂度和临床进展。引流、抗生素、胸膜腔内治疗、冲洗替代方案和外科手术应作为一条重新评估路径来讲授。

bleedingContext.anticoagulated: 治疗性抗凝无法安全暂停。

irrigation.title: Pleural Irrigation Trial 替代方案
irrigation.body: 当溶栓/酶疗法不适合或出血风险无法缓解时，可讨论生理盐水冲洗。
irrigation.note: 将冲洗视为一种经选择的替代路径，而非引流、联合治疗或外科手术的普遍替代。

bleeding.title: 出血叠加
bleeding.body: 本教学病例的估计出血信号：{percent}%。

uncomplicated.description: 当符合低风险特征时，抗生素加重新评估可能就足够。

complicated.description: 存在达引流标准的化验或影像特征。

empyema.description: 脓液或微生物学阳性使感染源控制成为明确指征。

reasons.frankPus: 在本教学模型中，明显脓液即为脓胸。
reasons.gramStain: 革兰染色阳性提示胸膜感染。
reasons.phLow: 胸膜 pH 为 7.20 或更低。
reasons.ldhHigh: 胸膜 LDH 高于 1000 IU/L。
reasons.imagingComplex: 影像具有高风险的复杂度或体积特征。
reasons.noDrainageFeatures: 本病例无达引流标准的化验、微生物学、脓液或复杂影像。

action.uncomplicated: 在适当情境下，抗生素加密切的临床重新评估可能是合理的。
action.complicated: 在安全时使用抗生素加小口径影像引导引流，然后重新评估。
action.empyema: 使用抗生素引流，并尽早重新评估感染源控制。

antibioticDuration.uncomplicated: 最多 2 周，根据临床反应调整。
antibioticDuration.complicated: 常为 2-4 周，根据感染源控制和临床反应调整。
antibioticDuration.empyema: 常为 4-6 周，根据引流、病原体和临床反应调整。

alteplase10Dnase5.label: 组织型纤溶酶原激活剂（tPA）10 mg 加 DNase 5 mg
alteplase10Dnase5.effect: 在 MIST2 教学中，联合治疗改善了影像学清除并减少了外科转诊和住院时间。
alteplase10Dnase5.caution: 评估出血风险和用药时机；不要把该剂量当作针对具体患者的建议。

alteplaseOnly.label: 单用 tPA
alteplaseOnly.effect: 单药纤溶治疗未显示出 MIST2 中相同的教学获益。
alteplaseOnly.caution: 避免把单药治疗作为首选路径来讲授。

dnaseOnly.label: 单用 DNase
dnaseOnly.effect: 单用 DNase 是一个教学陷阱，在 MIST2 中无获益。
dnaseOnly.caution: 使用联合治疗或替代策略，而非单用 DNase。

salineIrrigation.label: 胸膜冲洗
salineIrrigation.effect: 生理盐水冲洗是有初步数据支持的替代方案，可在溶栓药不适合或出血风险无法缓解时讨论。
salineIrrigation.caution: 应将其定位为经选择路径的教学，而非溶栓药或外科手术的普遍替代。

placebo.label: 安慰剂／仅引流
placebo.effect: 当达成感染源控制时，仅引流可能已足够，但残余积液需要早期重新评估。
placebo.caution: 当发热、炎症标志物、引流量或影像未改善时，不要延误升级。

bleedingNote.anticoagulated: 治疗性抗凝增加了出血方面的顾虑，应触发缓解方案的规划。
bleedingNote.baseline: 用于溶栓教学的胸膜基线出血信号为 4.1%。

pathway.scaffoldTitle: 恶性胸腔积液的诊断与管理路径
objectives: 解释为什么阴性细胞学不能排除恶性胸腔积液。
根据引流后的肺复张情况选择一条管理路径。
将胸膜固定术、留置胸膜导管或联合策略与患者目标相匹配。
howToUse: 设定非诊断性细胞学样本的数量，并查看升级警示。
选择引流后的肺复张模式。
在揭示路径推荐之前，预测管理分支。
pathway.clinicalAnchor: 一名患者有复发的、有症状的单侧胸腔积液，且尽管已做胸水检查，影像学特征仍使恶性肿瘤保留在鉴别诊断中。下一步取决于组织策略、肺复张、症状和目标。
pathway.keyTakeaway: 在恶性胸腔积液中，一次非诊断性穿刺并非终点。肺复张和患者目标决定了最值得教学的是胸膜固定术、留置胸膜导管还是联合策略。

full.label: 完全复张
full.description: 肺复张，胸膜表面可以贴合。

partial.label: 部分复张
partial.description: 症状改善，但仍残留未复张。

trapped.label: 被困或不可复张
trapped.description: 肺复张不足，胸膜固定术难以可靠见效。

management.pleurodesisCandidate: 可行胸膜固定术的路径
management.ipcOrRapidPleurodesis: 留置导管联合选定的快速胸膜固定策略
management.ipcPreferred: 以留置胸膜导管为中心的症状控制

revealCards.cytologyNote: 在一到两次非诊断性穿刺后，当怀疑仍然较高时，避免反复只做胸水检查。
revealCards.higherYieldNote: 手术耐受性、影像靶点、当地经验和患者目标仍然决定路径。

thoracentesis.title: 胸腔穿刺
thoracentesis.body: 快速的症状与诊断步骤；阴性细胞学需结合具体情况判断。

pleuroscopy.title: 胸膜腔镜
pleuroscopy.body: 组织诊断与 poudrage 选项；手术耐受性很重要。

ipc.title: 留置胸膜导管
ipc.body: 门诊症状控制；家庭引流支持和感染教育很重要。

pleurodesis.title: 胸膜固定术
pleurodesis.body: 当肺复张且患者能耐受操作时，以无装置为目标。

combined.title: 联合策略
combined.body: 选定的路径，将以导管为中心的门诊管理与胸膜固定意图相结合。

imageAlt.pleural-nodularity-ultrasound: 超声与 CT 对照，显示胸膜增厚和结节。
imageAlt.pleuroscopy-malignancy: 恶性间皮瘤与淋巴瘤的胸膜腔镜图像，伴窄带成像血管模式。
imageAlt.ipc-pleuroscope-equipment: 胸膜腔镜器械对比，以及活检钳的定位。

pathway.reflectionBody: 每个终点都应询问对该患者而言什么更重要：无住院天数、无装置的胸部、缓解的速度、家庭支持、预期预后、感染负担以及管理导管的意愿。

twoPlus.recommendation: 停止只做胸水检查的反复循环，当怀疑仍然较高时升级到胸膜活检、影像引导活检或胸膜腔镜。
twoPlus.teachingPoint: 当影像、病史或复发仍使 MPE 可能时，反复的非诊断性细胞学不应带来虚假的安心。

one.recommendation: 在选定病例中可考虑第二份细胞学样本，但如果验前概率较高，组织策略此时就应已显现。
one.teachingPoint: 一次非诊断性穿刺是一个分叉：可有选择地重复，但当怀疑持续较高时就应开始规划组织诊断。

zero.recommendation: 送检足量细胞学，并将结果与影像、肺复张、症状和患者目标结合起来。
zero.teachingPoint: 胸腔穿刺可以诊断部分 MPE，但阴性细胞学并非排除性检查。

branch.pleurodesisCandidate: 可复张的肺可根据目标和耐受性考虑滑石粉胸膜固定术、IPC 或联合门诊策略。
branch.ipcOrRapidPleurodesis: 部分复张更倾向于以 IPC 为中心的管理或选定的联合/快速胸膜固定策略，而非假定单用滑石粉即可见效。
branch.ipcPreferred: 被困或不可复张的肺使胸膜固定术难以成功；以 IPC 为中心的症状控制是核心教学分支。

yield.thoracentesis: 胸腔穿刺细胞学敏感性按大约 40-60% 教学，因此阴性结果需结合具体情况。
yield.pleuroscopy: 胸膜腔镜或胸膜活检通常提供更高产出的组织诊断，在本教学情境中约为 80-90%。

management.thoraReasonable: 如果积液腔安全且临床问题需要取样或缓解症状，胸腔穿刺可能是合理的。
management.considerTubeAndAdjuncts: 当感染、血液、包裹或恶性复杂性符合病例时，应考虑置管引流及辅助手段。
management.noPleuralDrainageTarget: 此视图未显示可供胸膜引流的目标；应引导学习者转向肺部模式的解读，或继续扫查以寻找积液。

patternTeaching.simpleAnechoic: 单纯无回声积液可能是漏出液或渗出液；图像并不能替代临床背景或胸膜积液分析。
patternTeaching.complexNonSeptated: 当积液腔可及时，复杂无分隔积液仍可安全取样，但其紧迫性由更广泛的病史决定。
patternTeaching.septatedLoculated: 分隔或小腔提示纤维蛋白、感染、血液或恶性复杂性，当临床背景相符时，应促使考虑引流/控制感染源。
patternTeaching.echogenic: 强回声积液令人担心脓液、血液、细胞碎屑或恶性病变；不要将其当作单纯的自由流动积液。
patternTeaching.noDrainableEffusion: 此视图未显示可引流的胸膜积液腔。B线、A线或胸膜下实变可能回答肺部问题，但它们并非胸腔穿刺的目标。

patternReveal.simpleAnechoic: 教学目标是一处单纯无回声腔；单纯的表现并不能证明是漏出液。
patternReveal.complexNonSeptated: 教学目标是复杂无分隔积液，有内部回声但无清晰的纤维蛋白条索。
patternReveal.septatedLoculated: 教学目标是有分隔或包裹的积液，提示纤维素性机化。
patternReveal.echogenic: 教学目标是强回声胸膜物质；脓液、血液、细胞碎屑或恶性病变都可造成这种表现。
patternReveal.noDrainableEffusion: 教学目标是此视图中的肺部模式，而无可引流的胸膜积液腔。

dynamicTeaching.normalALines: A线是含气肺产生的水平混响伪像。它们在胸膜模块中是有用的干扰项，因为它们不构成引流目标。
dynamicTeaching.bLinesPleuralIrregularity: B线起自胸膜线并随肺滑动而移动。它们回答的是间质或炎症性肺部问题，而非胸腔穿刺的目标。
dynamicTeaching.subpleuralConsolidation: 胸膜下实变可能紧贴胸膜，乍看之下像是操作目标。关键是继续扫查以寻找真正的积液窗。
dynamicTeaching.lungCurtainNoTarget: 帘征是含气肺的动态运动。在胸膜操作模块中，它是一个关键的无目标模式，尤其在膈肌附近。
dynamicTeaching.effusionAdjacentConsolidation: 积液加上实变的肺应使思路从「单纯穿刺」的惯性中跳出，转向感染、入路窗是否充分以及控制感染源的规划。

dynamicReveal.normalALines: 教学目标是滑动的胸膜线下方正常的 A线混响。
dynamicReveal.bLinesPleuralIrregularity: 教学目标是伴胸膜线不规则的 B线活动，而非胸膜积液腔。
dynamicReveal.subpleuralConsolidation: 教学目标是伴胸膜线不规则的胸膜下实变。
dynamicReveal.lungCurtainNoTarget: 教学目标是扫过肝脏的肺帘征，而非安全的积液腔。
dynamicReveal.effusionAdjacentConsolidation: 教学目标是积液伴邻近实变，这是比孤立的单纯积液腔风险更高的情境。

vignette.simple-anechoic-reference: 74 岁，利尿后呼吸困难，胸部影像示单侧积液。
vignette.complex-nonseptated-reference: 68 岁，复发性单侧积液、胸部不适及体重减轻。
vignette.septated-reference: 62 岁，肺炎、持续发热，抗生素治疗后出现胸膜积聚。
vignette.echogenic-reference: 56 岁，发热、胸膜炎性疼痛，尽管使用抗生素临床改善仍欠佳。
vignette.ambiguous-simple-exudate: 37 岁，有结核暴露风险、盗汗及单侧积液。
vignette.b-lines-no-effusion-distractor: 70 岁，呼吸困难，胸部影像示弥漫性间质改变，但无已知的胸膜积聚。
vignette.subpleural-consolidation-distractor: 59 岁，胸膜炎性症状及局灶性肺部发现，问题在于是否存在可供入路的胸膜腔。
vignette.atelectasis-with-effusion-reference: 66 岁，复发性单侧积液，胸膜腔视图内可见活动的组织。
vignette.dynamic-normal-a-lines: 一名患者的前胸扫查，问题在于胸膜线是否表现得像含气肺。
vignette.dynamic-b-lines-pleural-irregularity: 凸阵探头的肺部视频，在考虑引流之前，应先对垂直伪像和胸膜线纹理进行分类。
vignette.dynamic-subpleural-consolidation: 一名有局灶性胸膜旁异常患者的聚焦肺部视频；判断该视图是否显示可引流的腔。
vignette.dynamic-lung-curtain-no-target: 右下胸视频，须将活动的含气肺边界与胸膜积液目标区分开来。
vignette.dynamic-effusion-adjacent-consolidation: 肺炎背景下的视频，学习者须判断暗区及邻近组织是否代表胸膜操作的目标。

methods.limitationClassification: 第 1 阶段尚未启用 AI 相关性分类、专家验证、语义搜索或自然语言筛选规划。
methods.disclaimer: 仅供教育使用。搜索结果不能确定证据质量、推荐强度，也不能判断其是否适合某位患者或某项操作。

preferenceCards.title: IP Preference Card Builder
preferenceCards.subtitle: Resolve generic procedural requirements to hospital-local items, then review a spatial or chronological draft card.
preferenceCards.prototypeBanner: DRAFT PROTOTYPE — NOT APPROVED FOR CLINICAL USE
preferenceCards.disclaimer: For education and equipment-planning prototyping only. Actual setup, compatibility, availability, and use depend on current manufacturer IFUs, patient anatomy, institutional policy, local formulary approval, procedural conditions, and operator judgment.

preferenceCards.catalogAlternativesHelp: Counts required lines whose broad role has at least one catalog product. It does not establish exact-slot eligibility.

preferenceCards.reviewHelp: Inspect spatial setup, chronological workflow, exceptions, and the rule trace before generating.

admin.verificationWorkflowDescription: Read-only verification workbench for the effective catalog. It joins current product records, workbook backlog context, source claims, GUDID candidates, and procedure impact without applying any proposed change.
admin.verificationSafety: This workbench is for catalog quality assurance and educational review. GUDID is identity evidence only. Nothing here confirms current orderability, compatibility, local availability, formulary approval, clinical suitability, or patient-specific use, and this interface never changes canonical catalog data.
admin.verificationSearchPlaceholder: Product, manufacturer, catalog number, GTIN, ID, or candidate DI
admin.verificationSignal_backlog_drift: Workbook backlog differs from current catalog or GUDID evidence
admin.verificationAdditionNote: This product was added to the effective catalog after the workbook backlog snapshot. Review current source, identity, distribution, IFU, and local formulary evidence independently.
admin.verificationNoResultsHelp: Clear one or more filters to return to the full effective catalog.
admin.verificationReviewPathDescription: These states describe evidence availability only. They are not completion marks and do not approve a product, release visibility, establish exact-slot eligibility, or create a local formulary decision.
admin.verificationStepManufacturerAvailable: At least one manufacturer source is linked. Confirm that it covers the exact product and claims under review.
admin.verificationStepManufacturerMissing: No manufacturer source is linked. Primary-source verification remains required.
admin.verificationStepIdentityStrong: A manufacturer-and-catalog-number GUDID candidate exists. It remains a candidate until a reviewer confirms the exact configuration and package identity.
admin.verificationStepIdentityWeak: Only catalog-number matches from other manufacturers exist. These weak matches are not actionable identity evidence.
admin.verificationStepIdentityMissing: No local GUDID candidate is available. Identity discovery remains required.
admin.verificationStepDistributionIn: Strong GUDID records agree that the device is in commercial distribution. Current orderability still requires manufacturer or distributor confirmation.
admin.verificationStepDistributionNot: Strong GUDID evidence reports the device is not in commercial distribution. This does not establish discontinuation or catalog lifecycle; verify manufacturer status, local availability, successors, and installed-base handling separately.
admin.verificationStepDistributionConflict: Strong GUDID records disagree about distribution state. Resolve the exact device/package records before drawing any conclusion.
admin.verificationStepDistributionUnknown: No unambiguous strong distribution signal is available.
admin.verificationStepIfuAvailable: An IFU-labeled source is linked. A reviewer must still confirm revision, exact model, configuration, and applicable claims.
admin.verificationStepIfuMissing: No IFU-labeled source is linked. Current instructions for use and configuration review remain required.
admin.verificationStepFormularySeparate: Local availability, item numbers, UOM, storage, substitutions, and approval require a separate institutional process.
admin.verificationCurrentCatalogDescription: This merged record is authoritative for what the application currently displays. It does not by itself establish production or clinical approval.
admin.verificationBacklogSnapshotDescription: The backlog is a planning snapshot from the source workbook. Compare it with the current merged catalog before relying on its text.
admin.verificationBacklogGudidAgrees: Agrees with a current strong candidate
admin.verificationBacklogGudidDifferent: Differs from every current strong candidate
admin.verificationBacklogGudidNoCurrentStrong: Workbook DI has no current strong candidate
admin.verificationBacklogDriftBody: One or more workbook snapshot fields or DI suggestions differ from current effective evidence. Current values are displayed separately; nothing has been overwritten.
admin.verificationSourceEvidenceDescription: Source links preserve claim type, location, revision context, verification text, and use-policy limits. A source can support one claim without approving the whole product.
admin.verificationGudidEvidenceDescription: Every candidate is shown, including weak cross-manufacturer catalog-number collisions. Counts are candidate rows, not unique products, and no candidate is accepted automatically.
admin.verificationWeakWarning: Weak match: the manufacturer did not match. Do not use this row to backfill identifiers, infer distribution, or change visibility.
admin.verificationNoGudidCandidates: No GUDID candidate rows are available for this product.
admin.verificationProcedureImpactDescription: Broad product-role discovery, authored exact-slot options, unreviewed proposals, compatibility, and local approval remain separate relationships.
admin.verificationMappedUses: Mapped roles and authored slot uses
admin.verificationNoAuthoredSlots: No authored exact-slot option currently references this product.
admin.verificationUnreviewedSlotProposalsDescr: These rows come from broad role equality only. They are nonselectable and hidden until explicit review.
admin.verificationNoSlotProposals: No unreviewed exact-slot proposal references this product.
admin.verificationConceptBoundary: Product identity and specification evidence, catalog visibility, GUDID distribution evidence, exact-slot curation, compatibility, and institutional formulary approval answer different questions. Evidence in one layer never silently approves another.
admin.slotReviewDescription: Read-only inspection of products that share a broad role with a procedure slot but do not have an authored exact-slot option. This queue supports bounded human review without promoting proposals.
admin.slotReviewSafetyTitle: All proposals remain unreviewed and nonselectable
admin.slotReviewSafety: 宽泛角色相同并不能证明精确槽位适用性、尺寸或平台兼容性、包装身份、当前可订购性、本地目录批准或临床适用性。此页面不提供接受提案或将更改应用到目录的操作。
admin.slotReviewSearchPlaceholder: Product, catalog number, slot, procedure, role, or identifier
admin.slotReviewRowSafety: Inspection only. This proposal remains hidden and nonselectable; the canonical authored option set is unchanged.
admin.slotReviewNoResults: No exact-slot proposals match these filters.
admin.slotReviewNoResultsHelp: Clear one or more filters to return to all unreviewed proposals.

admin.openfdaDescription: Read-only identity-enrichment proposals compared with the canonical catalog and existing GUDID verification backlog.
admin.openfdaSafety: OpenFDA/GUDID enrichment supports device identity review only. A match does not establish current orderability, compatibility, local availability, formulary approval, or clinical suitability. All proposed changes require human verification against current manufacturer and institutional sources.
admin.openfdaEmptyTitle: No openFDA enrichment run is available
admin.openfdaEmptyBody: Run the server-side enrichment command to create a review queue. The canonical catalog and existing verification backlog are unchanged.
admin.openfdaNoResults: No openFDA proposal rows match these filters.
admin.mappingPrototype: Mapping edits require a migrated database and administrator permission.
admin.mappingSeedNote: This view shows the reviewed demo seed. Production mappings must be saved through the protected database action.
admin.catalogReadOnly: Read-only. GUDID candidates never overwrite canonical product identifiers.
admin.noResults: No backlog rows match these filters.
admin.formularyReadOnlyNote: Read-only coverage view: which procedure requirements resolve to a seeded item and which do not. Cards carry their own product choices, made from the catalog in the builder, so there is no shared formulary to edit here.
admin.eligibleProductCount: {count, plural, one {# catalogued product for this use} other {# catalogued products for this use}}
admin.modulesDescription: Every authored module version, the procedures composed from it, and what publishing a new version would touch.
admin.moduleImpactHelp: A composition pins an exact module version. Publishing a new version changes nothing until a procedure composition is updated to reference it, and saved snapshots never move.
admin.effectivePreviewHelp: Read-only. A requirement shown as inherited belongs to the module named beside it — changing it means publishing a new version of that module and updating the compositions that pin it.
admin.releasesDescription: 每个发布包都冻结了某一操作所依赖的全部编写内容——组合、其模块版本、修饰符集合、急救模块、类型化兼容性规则以及角色别名表——每一项都以内容哈希标识。已保存的卡片被锁定到某个发布包并始终保持锁定；更新的发布包绝不会回溯修改它。新卡片使用哪个发布包由明确的指针决定，而绝非通过版本比较得出。
admin.releaseImpact: 相对于所取代发布包的影响
admin.releaseNoChange: 卡片所依据的内容没有任何差异。
admin.releaseInitial: 首个发布包——无可比较对象。

catalog.metadataDescription: Search interventional pulmonology devices and disposables across manufacturers by use, size, and specification.
catalog.heading: Find the right device
catalog.description: Search every catalogued interventional pulmonology product, or browse by clinical use to compare what each manufacturer offers for the same job.

catalog.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No products} one {# product} other {# products}}
catalog.excludedMissingSpec: {count, plural, one {# product is hidden because this measurement is not recorded for it.} other {# products are hidden because this measurement is not recorded for them.}}
catalog.noResultsBody: Try removing a size range or manufacturer filter. Measurements are recorded for only part of the catalog, so narrow spec filters can exclude products that would otherwise fit.
catalog.invalidFilterBody: The {filter} value in this link is not in the catalog. Clear it and try again.
catalog.dataLanguageNote: Catalog product, manufacturer, and use names come from the source workbook and appear in English in every language.
catalog.disclaimer: Reference only. Confirm specifications, compatibility, and current availability against the manufacturer instructions for use and your institutional policy before clinical or purchasing decisions.

form.queryPlaceholder: Product name, brand, manufacturer, or catalog number
form.channelMaxHelp: Keeps products needing a working channel no larger than this.

verification.verifiedHelp: Specifications trace to a manufacturer document — a catalog, brochure, or instructions for use.
verification.candidateHelp: Seeded from user input with no primary source captured yet. Confirm with the manufacturer before relying on the details.
verification.usPendingHelp: Sourced from a manufacturer document, but current U.S. availability and labeling have not been confirmed.
verification.notDistributedHelp: GUDID reports that this device is not in commercial distribution. This evidence does not by itself determine catalog lifecycle, installed-base relevance, or local orderability.
verification.conflictingDistribution: Conflicting distribution evidence — manual verification required
verification.conflictingDistributionHelp: Strong matched GUDID rows disagree. Treat distribution as unresolved and verify manually; it does not determine lifecycle or orderability.
verification.legacyInstalledBaseHelp: This model remains relevant to programs that own and use it. Verify current new-purchase availability, service support, and accessory availability locally.
verification.regulatoryHelp: US regulatory posture, recorded separately from distribution evidence and local availability. Breakthrough Device designation means FDA agreed to an expedited review; it is not clearance or approval, and a designated device may not be marketed in the US until it is authorized.

product.compatibilityDisclaimer: Reproduced verbatim from the source catalog and not parsed or validated by this tool. Confirm against current instructions for use.

sets.metadataDescription: Define reusable equipment sets that satisfy several card requirements at once.
sets.title: Your equipment sets
sets.subtitle: Describe a tray once — the rigid set, the pleuroscopy cart — then use it on any card. Choosing a set satisfies every requirement it contains.
sets.heading: Sets
sets.description: A set lists the products a tray actually holds. When one instrument covers two requirements — a rigid scope with an integrated head, for example — mark the extra requirement under "Also satisfies" so the card stops asking for it separately.
sets.setDescriptionPlaceholder: Optional note — where it lives, who set it up
sets.noMembers: No products yet. Choose a requirement below and add from the catalog.
sets.coveredRolesHelp: Selecting this set on a card resolves the first of these and suppresses the rest.
sets.alsoCoversHelp: Requirements the set covers without a separate product — for a combined scope and head, tick the head here.
sets.emptyHelp: Create a set for the trays you use most. A rigid bronchoscopy set that contains the scope, barrels, and ventilation accessories can resolve all of those requirements in one selection.
sets.roleCount: {count, plural, one {# requirement covered} other {# requirements covered}}
sets.storageNote: Equipment sets are saved in this browser for now and are not yet synced to your account.

edit.editingHelp: Changes are saved back to this card. Its share link, sharing state, and creation date do not change.
edit.moduleCount: {count, plural, one {# setup module} other {# setup modules}}
edit.procedureLockedHelp: A saved card keeps the procedure and the exact recipe version it was built from, so its contents stay the ones that were reviewed. To build a different procedure, create a new card or duplicate this one.
edit.notEditableExplanation: This card was created with an earlier builder version and cannot be reopened for editing. Its saved snapshot remains available to view, print, share, duplicate, and retain for reference.
edit.unavailableTitle: This card cannot be reopened in the builder
edit.unavailableLegacy: This card was created with an earlier builder version and cannot be reopened for editing. Its saved snapshot remains available to view, print, share, duplicate, and retain for reference.
edit.unavailableProcedure: The procedure this card was built for is no longer published, so there is nothing for the builder to reopen it against.
edit.unavailableRecipeVersion: This card is pinned to a recipe version that is no longer published. Reopening it against a newer version would change what the card asks for, so the builder leaves it as saved.
edit.unavailableModule: A setup module this card was built from is no longer published at the version the card recorded. A different version is not substituted for it.
edit.unavailableCatalog: A product this card records can no longer be reconstructed from the catalog, so the builder cannot reopen it without changing what it says.
edit.unavailableSnapshotIntact: The saved card itself is unchanged and stays available to view, print, share, and duplicate.
edit.unavailableReleaseMissing: 创建此卡片所用的已发布版本不再保留，因此无法载入它所记录的确切定义。系统不会以其他版本替代。
edit.unavailableReleaseChanged: 创建此卡片所用的已发布版本与当初发布的内容不再一致——它锁定的某项定义已发生变更。此卡片按保存时的原样显示，而不会基于其作者从未审阅过的内容重新生成。
edit.unavailableSuperseded: 此卡片创建于发布包锁定完整规则集之前，因此重新打开会依据它从未记录过的准备规则重新生成。其保存的快照仍可查看、打印、共享、复制并留存备查。
edit.unavailableLegacyFamily: 此卡片使用目录浏览键而非经审核的产品系列来标识产品线，因此重新打开它意味着要判断该键在今天代表哪些产品。卡片按保存时的原样显示。
edit.unavailableCatalogRelease: 保存此卡片时所依据的目录版本已无法完整取回，因此无法重建它记录的产品与角色。不会以当前目录代替。
edit.unavailableModifier: 此卡片记录了一项其所锁定的操作发布包并未提供的准备选项，因此若不授予该发布包从未授予的权限便无法重新生成。
edit.staleEdit: This card was saved from somewhere else after you opened it. Reload to see the current version, then reapply your change — nothing you were looking at has been overwritten.

emerging.metadataDescription: FDA Breakthrough Device designated technologies in interventional pulmonology, recorded for orientation and deliberately excluded from preference-card selection.
emerging.heading: Breakthrough-designated devices
emerging.description: FDA Breakthrough Device designation means the agency agreed to review a device on an expedited path. It is not clearance, it is not approval, and it does not permit US marketing. These entries exist so the catalog can name what is coming without implying any of it is stocked — none of them can be added to a preference card.
emerging.noRoles: No catalog requirement maps to it yet.
emerging.excludedNotice: Excluded from every requirement, picker, and saved card by design.
emerging.evidenceCaveat: Every entry here rests on secondary, AI-generated research rather than a manufacturer document or an FDA decision record. Designation dates come from company announcements in most cases. Re-verify against the FDA PMA, 510(k), and De Novo databases before relying on anything below.

modules.sectionHelp: A card is assembled from reusable setup modules. Required modules are locked; the rest you decide.
modules.sectionIntro: These modules make up the complete card. Removing one removes only the requirements it contributes; adding it back restores them along with any selections you had already made.
modules.emptyComposition: This composition offers no modules yet, so the card has no requirements.
modules.previewRequirements: Show the requirements this module contributes
modules.lockedHelp: Required by this procedure and cannot be removed.
modules.noModifiersAvailable: No modifiers apply to this composition. Modifiers are authored against a procedure template.
modules.customTitle: Build a custom card from modules
modules.customDescription: Pick the setup modules yourself instead of starting from a standard procedure.
modules.customHelp: This is a card-building tool. Nothing is recommended for you — only the module descriptions the reviewers wrote are shown.

release.noCurrentRelease: 此操作目前没有当前已发布的版本，因此新卡片无法锁定到任何版本。缺少该版本时不会保存卡片。

reconcile.intro: This page compares your saved card with what the data underneath it says today. It is a read-only review: nothing here edits, rebuilds, upgrades, or re-saves the card, and the saved snapshot is untouched.
reconcile.sourceHelp: Every comparison below is against this exact saved state, named by its revision so it stays identifiable after the card is edited again.
reconcile.operationalHelp: The authored release, the pinned catalogue release, and every reviewed definition are held exactly as this card recorded them. Only what the room stocks, how the site ranks it, and what the location can do are read as they are today — so everything below is caused by those and by nothing else.
reconcile.operationalIdentical: Nothing has changed. Re-resolving this card against today's hospital-local data produces the card you saved.
reconcile.operationalHeldBroken: Something outside hospital-local data differs, which should not be possible while the release is held fixed: {keys}
reconcile.releaseHelp: How the release this card is pinned to compares with the release this procedure currently points at. The comparison is between the two definition sets; the card itself is never resolved against the newer one.
reconcile.releaseOnCurrent: This card is pinned to the release this procedure currently points at. There is nothing to compare.
reconcile.releaseNoCurrent: This procedure does not currently point at any published release, so there is nothing to compare this card's pinned release with.
reconcile.releaseIdentical: The two releases pin the same definitions. Nothing a card resolves from differs between them.
reconcile.releaseCatalogChanged: The two releases were published against different catalogue releases.
reconcile.releaseContractChanged: The two releases were published under different resolver contract versions.
reconcile.requirementChangesHelp: Matched on the reviewed requirement identity each line carries, and on nothing else — never on role code alone and never on resembling labels.
reconcile.hasSelection: You selected a product for it
reconcile.noRebuildNotice: Reviewing changes does not rebuild this card, and this page cannot: it reads and reports, and the card stays exactly as you saved it. Moving a card onto a newer release is a separate, reviewed workflow that creates a new card from one exact saved revision and leaves this one untouched — start it from the card’s own page.

revisions.heading: Saved states
revisions.help: Every state this card has been saved in, newest first. Revisions are append-only: they are written when the card is saved and are never rewritten.
revisions.empty: No saved states have been recorded for this card yet.
revisions.sameContent: Same content as the revision before it

rebuild.intro: This reviews one exact saved state of this card against the release this procedure points at today, and creates a NEW draft card from it. The card you are looking at is not changed, not upgraded, and not re-saved — it keeps its own release, its own snapshot, its own share link, and its own history.
rebuild.sourceHeading: What is being rebuilt, and onto what
rebuild.sourceHelp: The rebuild is bound to one immutable revision rather than to the card, so it stays identifiable after the card is edited again. The target is the release this procedure’s explicit pointer names — never the newest one by version or date.
rebuild.targetRelease: Release it would be built on
rebuild.sourceUnchangedNotice: Creating the new card writes one row. Nothing on this page can change the original card, its revisions, its snapshot, or its share link.
rebuild.decisionsHelp: Every requirement whose definition moved, every selection that could not be carried, and every requirement this release adds or removes has to be answered individually. There is no control that accepts them all at once.
rebuild.blockingHelp: The new card cannot ask for these. A required requirement whose selection could not be carried comes across empty, and the draft opens in the builder so a product can be chosen there.
rebuild.reviewHelp: The selection still exists and is still allowed, but something about the requirement, the product line, or the free text moved. It is offered as a suggestion and is not applied until you confirm it.
rebuild.addedHelp: Requirements this release expresses and the source revision never carried. They begin unresolved: no product is chosen for them, because nothing in the released definitions authors one.
rebuild.removedHelp: Requirements the newer release no longer expresses, and selections that no longer resolve against the target release’s catalogue or the equipment the room stocks.
rebuild.waiverHelp: A waiver is never carried. It records that a named person accepted a named risk under a named set of definitions, and under a different release those are not the same definitions. The earlier rationale is shown for reference only.
rebuild.carriedHelp: The requirement key, the released definition, and the exact identity of what was chosen are all unchanged, so these need no decision. They are listed so the review is a complete account rather than only the parts that moved.
rebuild.carriedCount: {requirements, plural, =0 {Nothing carried unchanged.} one {# requirement carried unchanged.} other {# requirements carried unchanged.}}
rebuild.createNotice: This creates a new draft card with its own id, its own share link switched off, and a record of the revision it was built from and the decisions you made. It is a draft: open it in the builder to finish anything left unresolved.
rebuild.unavailableTitle: This card cannot be rebuilt automatically
rebuild.unavailableSourceIntact: The card itself is unaffected. Its saved snapshot still views, prints, and shares exactly as it did.
rebuild.unavailableRevisionUnverifiable: This revision’s stored snapshot no longer matches the hash it was written with, so it cannot be shown or rebuilt from. Choose another revision from the card’s history.
rebuild.unavailableLegacy: This revision was written before the builder recorded selections in a form that can be mapped forward, so there is nothing to carry.
rebuild.unavailableSuperseded: This revision predates release pinning, so the definitions it resolved through were never recorded. Rebuilding it would mean choosing which rules it was built against, which is a decision no automatic mapping is entitled to make.
rebuild.unavailableLegacyFamily: This revision names a product line by a catalogue-browsing key rather than a reviewed family. Deciding which products that key stands for today would be a guess about what the physician is asking the room for.
rebuild.unavailableSourceRelease: The release this revision pins is no longer retrievable intact, so what it was built from cannot be reconstructed to compare against.
rebuild.unavailableNoCurrentRelease: Nothing currently points at a release for this procedure, so there is no target to rebuild onto. The release a card moves to is always read from the explicit pointer, never inferred from version numbers or dates.
rebuild.unavailableAlreadyCurrent: This revision is already pinned to the release this procedure points at, so a rebuild would produce a copy rather than move anything. Editing the card re-resolves it against today’s equipment.
rebuild.unavailableTargetNotSelectable: The release this procedure points at is a draft or has been retired, and neither can back a new card.
rebuild.unavailableTargetRelease: The release this procedure points at cannot be reconstructed intact, so nothing can be mapped onto it.
rebuild.unavailableTargetCatalog: The catalogue release the target release pins is no longer retained, so product identity on the new card could not be reconstructed.
rebuild.unavailableComposition: The requested composition includes a module or modifier the target release does not offer.

error.review_incomplete: Every changed or unresolved decision has to be answered before a new card can be created. The ones still needing an answer are highlighted below.
error.plan_moved: The definitions underneath this rebuild changed while the page was open, so the decisions recorded on it describe choices this rebuild would no longer make. The plan below is the current one; please read it again.
error.not_resolvable: The reviewed selections do not resolve into a card against the target release. Nothing was created.
error.write_failed: The new card could not be saved. Nothing was created.
error.plan_blocked: This rebuild cannot be planned: the target release expresses a requirement in more than one way, so there is no single requirement to carry a selection onto. Nothing was created, and the release itself has to be corrected first.
error.source_moved: The card this rebuild was taken from has changed or been deleted since the review, so nothing was created.
error.review_unavailable: 构成本次审阅的其中一项比较无法计算，因此没有可审阅的内容，也没有创建任何卡片。

selectionKind.hospital_item: an item from your local list
selectionKind.unknown: a selection with no stored record

reason.requirement_unchanged: The released definition of this requirement is unchanged.
reason.requirement_definition_changed: The newer release defines this requirement differently.
reason.requirement_added_by_target: The newer release adds this requirement.
reason.requirement_removed_by_target: The newer release no longer expresses this requirement.
reason.requirement_key_absent_from_snapshot: The saved snapshot does not carry a reviewed identity for this line, so nothing can be matched to it.
reason.provenance_only_module_move: The requirement moved between modules without any change to what it asks for.
reason.selection_absent_in_source: The saved selection has no stored record to rebuild from.
reason.selection_deliberately_empty: This requirement was deliberately left unselected.
reason.hospital_item_not_offered: The item chosen for this requirement is no longer offered for it.
reason.catalog_product_unavailable: The product chosen is not in the catalogue release the target release pins.
reason.catalog_product_role_ineligible: The product chosen is not mapped to this requirement’s role in the target release.
reason.family_version_unavailable: The reviewed product line is no longer retained.
reason.family_version_changed: The reviewed membership of this product line has moved since it was chosen, so it stands for a different set of products.
reason.family_catalog_release_mismatch: The product line was reviewed against a different catalogue release from the one this rebuild pins.
reason.family_identity_not_reviewed: The product line is still a draft awaiting clinical review and cannot back a card selection.
reason.family_role_not_covered: The product line no longer serves this requirement’s role.
reason.custom_item_requires_review: A line you wrote yourself carries no catalogue identity, so nothing can establish that it still says the right thing.
reason.custom_not_allowed_by_target: The newer release does not allow a written-in line for this requirement.
reason.equipment_set_member_unavailable: A product in this equipment set is not in the catalogue release the target release pins.
reason.equipment_set_role_not_covered: The equipment set does not cover this requirement’s role.
reason.conditional_rule_changed: The rule this include-or-exclude decision was made against has changed, so the earlier answer was to a different question.
reason.compatibility_rejected: The target release’s compatibility rules reject this selection.
reason.resolution_unresolved: This requirement resolves to nothing on the new card.
reason.module_unchanged: This module is unchanged between the two releases.
reason.module_version_changed: The newer release pins a different version of this module.
reason.module_behavior_changed: The newer release offers this module on different terms.
reason.module_not_offered: The newer release does not offer this module.
reason.module_newly_offered_on_by_default: The newer release offers this module and turns it on by default, adding requirements the source card never carried.
reason.module_required_by_target: The newer release requires this module.
reason.modifier_unchanged: This modifier is unchanged between the two releases.
reason.modifier_definition_changed: The newer release defines this modifier differently.
reason.modifier_not_offered: The newer release does not offer this modifier.
reason.waiver_never_carries: A waiver is never carried forward. If the new card raises this warning, enter a new waiver against it there.
reason.waiver_warning_absent_from_target: The requirement this waiver was entered against is not on the new card.
reason.requirement_key_ambiguous: The target release expresses this requirement in more than one way, so there is no single requirement to carry a selection onto.
reason.room_capability_missing: This modifier needs a room capability this location does not have.
reason.target_presence_changed: The target release covers this requirement with a kit, so it is suppressed rather than listed.

rebuild.comparisonsHelp: The two read-only reviews this rebuild was planned against, in full. The digests above identify them and are written into the new card as the record of what was compared; these are the comparisons themselves.
rebuild.targetResolutionHeading: What the new card resolves to
rebuild.targetResolutionHelp: The proposed selections resolved through the release this rebuild targets. Anything here that a decision below does not already account for is a change this rebuild would introduce.
rebuild.targetReadiness: Readiness of the card this rebuild would create: {readiness}.
rebuild.targetNoWarnings: The target release raises nothing against the carried selections.
rebuild.targetUnresolvable: The proposed selections do not resolve into a card against the target release, so no card can be created from this plan.
rebuild.otherHeading: 目标版本的处理结果不同
rebuild.otherHelp: 这些条目已经带入，但目标版本对它们的处理不同：组合被拒绝、不再单独准备，或者现在需要准备。创建新卡片前每一项都需要作答。
rebuild.presenceMove: 在新卡片上，此条目从{before}变为{after}。
rebuild.unavailableNotice: 目前无法提供此次重建。构成本次审阅的其中一项比较无法计算，因此没有可审阅的内容，也无法据此创建卡片。

blocker.operational_comparison_unavailable: 无法计算医院当前本地数据对该版本的影响。
blocker.release_comparison_unavailable: 无法计算已锁定版本与当前版本之间的差异。
blocker.target_projection_unavailable: 无法在目标版本下解析新卡片，因此本次审阅无法描述它。

rebuild.provenanceHelp: 本卡片由另一张卡片某一确切的已保存状态构建而成，采用较新的版本，并在每一项发生变化的决定都经过审阅之后生成。以下记录在创建卡片时一次写入，此后不可更改。
rebuild.provenanceSourceAvailable: 构建自某张仍然存在的卡片的第 {revision} 版。
rebuild.provenanceSourceLink: 打开源卡片的历史记录
rebuild.provenanceSourceGone: 构建本卡片所依据的卡片此后已被删除，其各版本也随之消失。以下标识符与哈希值仍准确记录了当时审阅的内容，若存在该版本的副本可据此核对；但该版本本身已不可用，也无法由本记录还原。
rebuild.provenanceDecisionsHelp: 共 {total} 项决定中有 {answered} 项需要作答，其余原样带入。
rebuild.provenanceUnreadableHeading: 无法读取本卡片的重建记录
rebuild.provenanceUnreadableBody: 数据库显示本卡片由一次经审阅的重建生成，但其所带记录的格式不是本版本应用能够解读的。卡片本身没有任何变化，仍可正常使用；无法显示的只是它的生成过程。请反馈此问题——该记录为一次性写入，因此内容完好，待查明不一致原因后即可读取。

consequence.readinessChanged: 将卡片的就绪状态由{from}变为{to}

devices.metadataDescription: Read-only atlas of verified interventional pulmonology devices with source citations.
devices.title: Device Atlas
devices.intro: A read-only reference of interventional pulmonology devices, restricted to catalog products whose specifications trace to a verified source and which are cleared for prototype display. Every fact carries its citation.
devices.cohortRule: Cohort rule: verification_grade = verified_source AND visibility_state = prototype_visible.
devices.exclusionNote: Candidate-grade and hidden catalog products are not shown here. They remain reviewable on the existing public-unlisted (direct-link) catalog surfaces.
devices.unknownFilter: The "{filter}" filter value is not recognized.
devices.excludedMissingSpec: {count, plural, one {# product was} other {# products were}} excluded only because the filtered specification is not recorded for it.
devices.noResults: No products in the atlas cohort match these filters.

device.metadataDescription: Verified device facts with source citations.
device.specsMissingNote: A value shown as "not recorded" means the source documents reviewed so far do not state it — not that the device lacks it.
device.rolesDiscoveryNote: Role membership is a catalog-discovery fact recorded in the governed product–role table. It is not a clinical equivalence or substitution claim.
device.noRoles: No clinical-role mappings are recorded for this product.
device.proceduresNote: Slots where this product is an authored option in a procedure template. All procedures shown are governance drafts; each carries its verbatim status.
device.ruleConditionNote: Displayed as an authored condition. Nothing is evaluated on this page — evaluation happens only inside the preference-card resolver.
device.noCompatibilityData: No compatibility statements are recorded for this product.
device.noSources: No source citations are recorded for this product.
device.displayOnlyGroupingNote: Display-only grouping by manufacturer and product line for discovery. It is never persisted as identity and is not a clinical equivalence group.
device.otherManufacturersHeading: Other manufacturers with products mapped to this clinical role
device.roleDiscoveryCaption: Shared clinical-role mapping is a catalog-discovery fact, not a claim that these products are clinically equivalent or substitutable.
device.otherManufacturersSelectionNote: One product per manufacturer, drawn from {productCount, plural, one {# cohort product} other {# cohort products}} across {manufacturerCount, plural, one {# other manufacturer} other {# other manufacturers}} mapped to this role ({shown} shown). Representatives prefer primary-fit mappings and are otherwise arbitrary — never a matched or comparable set, and sizes are not matched.
device.otherManufacturersViewRole: View every cohort product mapped to this role.

role.metadataDescription: One clinical role across manufacturers, with authored selection guidance quoted verbatim.
role.membershipNote: Products listed under this role share a catalog-discovery mapping. Role membership is a discovery fact — it is not clinical equivalence, interchangeability, or a substitution recommendation.
role.guidanceVerbatim: Quoted verbatim from the governed role table; never paraphrased.
role.guidanceGenericNote: Authored selection guidance is generic educational content from the governed role table. Wording that mentions a formulary or hospital stocking is template language only — it does not establish that any hospital carries, stocks, prefers, approves, or uses any product.
role.productsHeading: Atlas products mapped to this role ({count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}})
role.cohortNote: Only the Phase D1 atlas cohort is listed here (verified source, prototype-visible). Additional mapped products may exist on the existing public-unlisted (direct-link) catalog surfaces. Counts reflect catalog-ingestion coverage, not market availability.
role.noCohortProducts: No products in the D1 atlas cohort are mapped to this role.
role.proceduresHeading: Procedures and slots using this role
role.proceduresNote: Every procedure template slot that requests this role, with its authored-option status. All procedures are governance drafts.
role.noProcedures: No procedure slots request this role.

evidence.verifiedSource: Product specifications trace to a verified primary source (for example GUDID/UDI or a manufacturer IFU), cited on the device page.
evidence.authoredSelectable: A clinician-authored, reviewed slot option that the preference-card builder may select.
evidence.authoredNonSelectable: An authored slot option that reviewers deliberately hold out of selection; shown for context only.

readiness.metadataDescription: Deterministic demo-data-only readiness projection for a Phase D1 exemplar procedure.
readiness.title: Demo readiness — {procedure}
readiness.demoTitle: DEMO DATA — NOT AN ACTUAL INSTITUTION
readiness.demoDisclaimer: Every state below is computed from the fictional "Demo IP Program" context to prove the deterministic rules against real catalog structure. It reports on no real room, no real inventory, and no real institution, and makes no procurement recommendation.
readiness.realFormularyHeadline: Not ready — no institutional data recorded.
readiness.realFormularyBody: {rows} formulary staging rows intersect the roles of this procedure; {carried} are marked as carried and {preferred} as preferred. The scaffold holds no institutional signal.
readiness.realFormularyNote: This empty scaffold is not institutional data and is never presented as such. The projection below runs on the explicitly fictional demo context instead.
readiness.demoProjectionNote: Evaluated for {organization} · {location} with the scenario default modifiers ({modifiers}), through the existing resolver — this page adds a pure projection over its output and persists nothing.

evidence.noMapping: No institutional mapping in the demo context.

readiness.noRescueDefinedFact: No rescue module is defined for this procedure. This is reported as a fact of the release-pinned composition, not as a missing-rescue-pathway state.

legend.ready: The demo mapping is an authored selectable option on a verified-source product and no limitation applies (spec §4 rule 1). Any resolver advisory about the mapping — for example a pending current-local-verification check — is quoted verbatim beneath the state chip.
legend.ready_with_limitations: Coverage exists but at least one limitation applies — a demo stand-in, candidate-grade evidence, an unresolved conditional requirement, or a compatibility check that evaluated unknown.
legend.not_ready: At least one required requirement has no institutional mapping at all.
legend.missing_required_product_role: A required requirement whose role has no authored selectable option anywhere in the catalog (proposals-only or wholly unmapped) — a structural gap independent of any institution.
legend.missing_room_capability: A room capability named by the composition or a selected modifier is absent from the location context — the same check that produces the resolver’s blocking message.
legend.missing_rescue_pathway: A reachable rescue module has a requirement with no coverage, or the module itself fails to resolve.
legend.available_but_unverified: Coverage exists only through unverified evidence: a demo-only or unverified mapping, a candidate/unknown-grade product, or a compatibility rule that could not be evaluated. Never a silent pass.
legend.inventory_formulary_mismatch: An institutional assertion disagrees with authored eligibility — for example a carried product that is not an authored selectable option. It cannot fire from a scaffold that carries no assertions.

readiness.legendSafetyNote: Safety rules: candidate or unknown evidence never produces plain Ready; demo stand-ins always force a limitation; unreviewed proposals never count as coverage; a missing attribute resolves to unknown rather than passing.
readiness.noProcurementNote: This is a demo/readiness gap preview over fictional data. It is not a procurement report, a shortage analysis, or a substitution recommendation for any hospital.
readiness.otherWarnings: {count, plural, one {# other resolver message, quoted verbatim} other {# other resolver messages, quoted verbatim}}
readiness.realFormularyHeadlineNonEmpty: Formulary staging rows carry institutional assertions. Phase D1 shows them as data only; institutional readiness remains unevaluated.
readiness.realFormularyLocalFields: {count, plural, one {# row carries} other {# rows carry}} a populated local field, shown for honesty about what the scaffold holds.

outputs.heading: Read-only output previews
outputs.readOnlyNote: Every view is a deterministic projection of one exact release-pinned resolved demo card. Nothing is saved, persisted, or written.

card.heading: Preference card — existing builder
card.body: Preference cards remain the existing engine, unchanged. This workspace links into the builder for the matching scenario; it does not duplicate it.
card.builderNote: The builder opens in the preserved preference-cards area with its own access rules; saving a card requires an account.

nursing.allUnassignedNote: No resolved requirement of this procedure carries a responsible role, so this preview cannot group by role yet. Until responsible roles are authored, its line set is identical to the Training preview; the list below is shown flat, without a role grouping.

training.authoredOnlyNote: Every clinical sentence below is authored text quoted from the governed catalog (generic requirement, selection guidance, dependency rule). Nothing is machine-generated.
training.currentIfuAdvisory: Role flagged as requiring current instructions-for-use review before clinical use.
training.currentIfuUniversalNote: Every role in this preview is flagged as requiring current instructions-for-use review before clinical use — stated once here instead of repeated on every line.

gaps.demoOnlyNote: Demo/readiness gap preview — structural gaps in the governed catalog plus the demo projection. Because no real institution exists in this system, this is NOT a procurement report for any hospital.
gaps.proposalsOnlyRoles: Roles covered only by unreviewed proposals
gaps.proposalsNote: Proposal counts are shown for review load only; proposals never satisfy coverage.
gaps.unmappedRoles: Roles with no option and no proposal
gaps.nonSelectableRoles: Roles with authored but non-selectable options only
gaps.dimensionGapCount: {count, plural, one {# authored-option product has} other {# authored-option products have}} all eight dimension fields empty.
gaps.formularyBody: No institutional inventory is recorded: {rows} staging rows intersect this procedure, {carried} carried, {preferred} preferred.

outputs.demoDisclaimer: These previews resolve the fictional "Demo IP Program" context. They describe no real room, no real inventory, and no real institution, and they make no procurement recommendation.

suppressed.heading: Included in a selected kit — not listed separately
suppressed.note: The resolver records these requirements as satisfied by a selected kit's bill of materials. They are suppressed from the lists above and shown here — never silently dropped.

packet.heading: Printable setup packet
packet.body: This packet is for education and device setup review only. Actual use depends on patient anatomy, device model, accessory compatibility, current manufacturer instructions, procedural conditions, local policy, and operator judgment.
packet.noResponsibleRole: Responsible role is not recorded on any resolved requirement. This packet leaves ownership unassigned and does not infer a role.
packet.setupNote: Lines follow setup sequence within their authored setup zones. Requiredness, dependencies, unresolved states, and evidence states remain visible.
packet.suppressedNote: These requirements remain part of the card record but the resolver suppressed a separate pull because a selected kit includes them.
packet.diagnosticsNote: Messages are copied from the same resolved card. Acknowledgment does not change severity or readiness impact.
packet.provenanceNote: This appendix comes from the same resolved card. Product identities held behind the Device Intelligence cohort wall remain withheld.
packet.tableRegionLabel: Requirement source and provenance table (scrolls horizontally)
packet.withheldEvidence: Identity withheld from this public view
packet.footer: Read-only demo draft. Confirm every item against current manufacturer instructions, local policy, actual inventory, procedural conditions, and operator judgment. This packet does not establish readiness for a real case.
